end.summary:
• Practised ordering BCE and CE dates on a timeline.
• Correctly ordered 3000 BCE, 500 BCE, 100 CE, and 1947 CE.
• Explained that BCE numbers count down toward 1 BCE.
• Judged that historians cross-check a ruler’s written claim with other sources.
• Clarified that 1 BCE comes immediately before 1 CE; a visual timeline was requested for further practice.
end.parentNote: Asha practised placing BCE dates from larger to smaller numbers, followed by CE dates from smaller to larger numbers. Aarav used the number-line method and correctly ordered the sample dates. They initially mixed up the CE side and asked for clarification; this was corrected later by stating that 1 BCE is immediately before 1 CE. At home, draw a short timeline together and place 3 BCE dates and 3 CE dates on it, saying the order aloud.
